content.text: In many countries, digital creators face significant barriers when it comes to setting up online stores that accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-every-detail-you-6|Payment Solutions]]s-tanzanian-online-sellers-everything-you-need-6|crypto]] payments. For instance, platforms like Stripe and PayPal remain inaccessible in several regions, leaving creators seeking reliable alternatives. COREMERCH offers two distinct stacks: Stack 01 with GitHub Pages and Stack 02 featuring [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-21|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages. This comparison will help you decide which infrastructure is best suited for your digital store needs.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Stack 01 provides a straightforward deployment process using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, allowing you to get your store up and running within 4-6 hours. It's ideal for creators who prefer simplicity and control. In contrast, Stack 02 leverages Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a more robust architecture, ensuring higher performance and scalability. Deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, Stack 02 is end-to-end tested before handoff, offering a more comprehensive solution that includes advanced configurations like SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both stacks are designed with creators in restricted countries in mind, eliminating reliance on conventional payment platforms. Stack 01 offers a great starting point with free hosting and integration of NOWPayments to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. However, Stack 02 enhances this with a more resilient backend, allowing for seamless operations even in countries facing severe financial isolation. By utilizing Cloudflare’s services, Stack 02 ensures that your store remains accessible, secure, and less likely to be affected by regional restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

With both stacks, payment processing is streamlined via NOWPayments, which charges a minimal 0.5% fee on transactions. In terms of speed, Stack 01 may present slight delays due to its simpler infrastructure, while Stack 02, thanks to its advanced backend setup, can handle higher transaction volumes with greater efficiency. Both stacks allow you to accept crypto payments quickly, with recommended networks like BSC and Solana ensuring transaction costs remain below $0.10.
Stack 01 is fast to deploy, perfect for individual creators.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a crucial factor in the COREMERCH offering. After deployment, customers retain full control and ownership of their store, with no ongoing subscriptions or platform dependencies. Stack 01 enables creators to automate order fulfillment through Google Apps Script, while Stack 02 offers a more sophisticated automation potential with integrated Supabase for order management. Each stack ensures that once a payment is confirmed, product delivery is instantaneous, providing a seamless experience for end-users.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you require a quick setup and straightforward functionality, Stack 01 is the right choice. It’s particularly suited for individual creators looking to launch with minimal overhead. However, if your focus is on scalability, performance, and advanced features, Stack 02 is a clear winner, especially for businesses anticipating growth. By analyzing your current and future needs, you can make an informed decision that aligns with your goals as a digital creator.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by choosing a solid infrastructure like COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02. Stack 01 can be deployed in under six hours, while Stack 02 offers a more robust solution with deployment in 48 hours, both allowing seamless crypto payment acceptance.
Stack 02 offers advanced features and scalability for growing businesses.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up my digital store using Stack 01?

To set up your digital store using Stack 01, deploy GitHub Pages, configure Google Apps Script for order processing, and integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This process typically takes 4-6 hours.
What are the limitations of using Stack 01?

Stack 01, while efficient for simple setups, may lack scalability for larger operations. It also relies on Google Apps Script, which has limitations in handling complex backend logic compared to Stack 02.
Can I switch from Stack 01 to Stack 02 later?

Yes, you can transition from Stack 01 to Stack 02 if your needs evolve. However, be prepared for some migration effort, as it involves reconfiguring your store on Cloudflare Pages and integrating the new backend.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Both stacks come with a 30-day support period after deployment. Stack 02, however, includes more comprehensive end-to-end testing, ensuring a smoother handoff.
What happens to my data after deployment?
After deployment, you retain full ownership of your data on both stacks, ensuring you have complete control without any ongoing dependencies on COREMERCH.
Both stacks ensure you maintain full ownership and control of your digital store.
